verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a vendor-hosted card-issuing and processing platform, and self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Pomelo can be deployed or run on customer infrastructure. The Stage environment runs on Pomelo's own domains, and the option to authorize transactions with your own authorizer is an adjacent integration choice, not a self-hosted core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
